            "definition": " WITH base AS (\n         SELECT u.id AS usuario_id,\n            rp.codigo AS rol,\n            COALESCE(u.acceso_todos_tenants, false) AS acceso_todos_tenants\n           FROM usuarios u\n             JOIN usuario_roles ur ON ur.usuario_id = u.id AND ur.activo = true\n             JOIN roles_portal rp ON rp.id = ur.rol_id AND rp.activo = true\n        )\n SELECT DISTINCT b.usuario_id,\n    t.id AS tenant_id,\n    b.rol,\n        CASE\n            WHEN b.rol::text = 'RESELLER'::text AND b.acceso_todos_tenants = true THEN 'TODOS'::text\n            ELSE 'ASIGNADO'::text\n        END AS origen_acceso\n   FROM base b\n     JOIN tenants t ON b.rol::text = 'RESELLER'::text AND b.acceso_todos_tenants = true OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1\n           FROM tenant_usuarios tu\n          WHERE tu.usuario_id = b.usuario_id AND tu.tenant_id = t.id AND tu.activo = true));",

            "view_name": "vw_consumo_mensual",
            "definition": " SELECT c.tenant_id,\n    cd.linea_servicio_id,\n    to_char(cd.fecha_utc::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMM'::text) AS periodo,\n    sum(cd.priority_gb) AS priority_gb,\n    sum(cd.opt_in_priority_gb) AS opt_in_priority_gb,\n    sum(cd.standard_gb) AS standard_gb,\n    sum(cd.non_billable_gb) AS non_billable_gb,\n    sum(cd.priority_gb + cd.standard_gb + cd.non_billable_gb) AS total_gb\n   FROM consumo_diario cd\n     JOIN lineas_servicio ls ON ls.id = cd.linea_servicio_id\n     JOIN cuentas c ON c.id = ls.cuenta_id\n  GROUP BY c.tenant_id, cd.linea_servicio_id, (to_char(cd.fecha_utc::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMM'::text));",

            "view_name": "vw_costo_mes_base_v2",
            "definition": " SELECT csm.id,\n    csm.tenant_id,\n    csm.periodo,\n    csm.linea_servicio_id,\n    csm.dispositivo_id,\n    csm.unidad_nivel1_id,\n    csm.unidad_nivel2_id,\n    csm.unidad_nivel3_id,\n    csm.centro_costo_id,\n    csm.consumo_priority_gb,\n    csm.consumo_standard_gb,\n    csm.consumo_non_billable_gb,\n    csm.consumo_total_gb,\n    csm.wan_rx_bytes,\n    csm.wan_tx_bytes,\n    csm.latencia_avg_ms,\n    csm.packet_loss_avg,\n    csm.downlink_avg_mbps,\n    csm.uplink_avg_mbps,\n    csm.signal_quality_avg,\n    csm.obstruccion_avg,\n    csm.disponibilidad_pct,\n    csm.costo_starlink,\n    csm.moneda_starlink,\n    csm.importe_comprobante_cliente,\n    csm.moneda_cliente,\n    csm.criterio_asignacion_costo,\n    csm.fecha_calculo,\n    csm.detalle_json,\n    n1.codigo AS unidad_nivel1_codigo,\n    n1.nombre AS unidad_nivel1_nombre,\n    n2.codigo AS unidad_nivel2_codigo,\n    n2.nombre AS unidad_nivel2_nombre,\n    n3.codigo AS unidad_nivel3_codigo,\n    n3.nombre AS unidad_nivel3_nombre,\n    cc.codigo AS centro_costo_codigo,\n    cc.nombre AS centro_costo_nombre\n   FROM costo_servicio_mes csm\n     LEFT JOIN unidades_organizacionales n1 ON n1.id = csm.unidad_nivel1_id\n     LEFT JOIN unidades_organizacionales n2 ON n2.id = csm.unidad_nivel2_id\n     LEFT JOIN unidades_organizacionales n3 ON n3.id = csm.unidad_nivel3_id\n     LEFT JOIN centros_costos cc ON cc.id = csm.centro_costo_id;",
